title: Objection addressed follow-up
situation: The buyer raised something, the rep answered it on the call, and it is worth putting in writing.
notes: Sybill's nearest cousins are all internal manager reports. This is the rep-facing outbound version. It sits low in the ladder on purpose: a demo call, a pricing call, and a close call all answer objections, and each of those has a template that says more.

panel.explainer: The objection answered on this call picked this template. A free model drafted it. The gate checked every line.

subject: Following up on your questions

blocks.text: Thanks for the time today. Wanted to follow up on a couple of things you raised.

blocks.label: What we covered
blocks.hint: Each concern the buyer raised, and how it was answered on the call.

blocks.label: Next steps
blocks.hint: Anything agreed off the back of those answers.

blocks.text: Rewrite the lines above as one short email in the second person. Every sentence that says something about the call must carry the claim id it came from. Do not claim a concern is settled unless the claim says the buyer accepted it. Short sentences.
Every line above came from something said on the call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.
